title: Notice by Central Recruitment Board dated 24.03.2026
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
By Email
Government of Meghalaya
OFFICE OF THE CHAIRMAN
CENTRAL RECRUITMENT BOARD
MEGHALAYA POLICE :: MAWROH :: SHILLONG
Phone No. (+91) 6033431188 Email ID: crb-mlp@meghalaya.gov.in
NOTICE
Reference to this office Memo No. CRB/ MLP/ RECR/ 52/ 2025 - 26/ 54 – A dated
25th February, 2026, it is to inform that the verification of candidates whose roll numbers have been withheld
earlier while publishing of the selected list for the 8 (eight) posts has been completed by this office.
The candidates whose results are withheld earlier are hereby directed to visit the office of the
Central Recruitment Board, Meghalaya Police at Mawroh or contact the helpline numbers – 0364 – 7966980/
6033431188 during office hours for clarifications on or before the 31st March, 2026 positively.
Those candidates who have medical conditions specified as general grounds for rejection so as
to impede efficient discharge of training/ duties as laid down in the CRB Rules are not eligible for
appointment and their candidatures have been rejected on such grounds.
Note: The verification of candidates is a continuous process throughout the entire Recruitment and on such
verification if any error/anomaly is detected, the candidates may be terminated/rejected from the recruitment/
appointment at any stage even if their names appear in the selection list.
Sd/-
(Shri Dalton P Marak, IPS)
Inspector General of Police, (SB/Bdr.),
Cum- Chairman,
Central Recruitment Board,
Meghalaya Police, Shillong.
Memo No. CRB/ MLP/ RECR/ 52/ 2025 - 26/ 93 – A Dated Shillong, the 24th March, 2026.
Copy to: -
1. The Assistant Inspector General of Police, (A), Meghalaya, Shillong for favour of kind information of
the Director General of Police, Meghalaya, Shillong with a request for putting up the notice in the
Meghalaya Police website.
2. The Deputy Inspector General of Police (ER, Shillong) and (WR, Tura), Meghalaya, for favour of kind
information.
3. The Director, Information & Public Relations, Meghalaya, Shillong for information with a request to
publish the above notice in one English (Shillong Times), one Khasi and one Garo Newspaper in the
State for wide publicity.
4. All the Superintendents of Police and all Commandants of Battalions for kind information and wide
publicity.
5. All Electronic Media Houses in the state for wide publicity.
(Shri Lakador Syiem, IPS)
Member Secretary,
Central Recruitment Board,
Meghalaya Police, Shillong.
